dollar: FRED DTWEXBGS broad USD, not ICE DXY; keep approved long history and 2019+ vintage restriction
source_connector: Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT daily UTC as a separate source comparison; never splice USDT into USD history
calendar_information_rule: At start of UTC day D, use original date-level information row D-2 (24h beyond its reference close). Macro levels carry last admitted vintage. VIX uses historical observation D-3 or earlier, explicitly a lagged proxy. No bfill, no filling crypto prices.
calendar_shocks: Difference of adjacent available-information LEVELS, not carrying the last nonzero change. VIX points, USD log change percent, Treasury bps. Revisions/observation substitution may enter these information updates, so they are not pure structural shocks.

LP.outcome: sum of daily crypto log returns D through D+h-1; h calendar days after information cutoff
LP.stress: last admitted VIX proxy >30, fixed before outcome
LP.BH: full/pre/post coefficients family 720; pooled stress differences separately family 240; state CIs are pointwise only

joint_VAR.sample: common observed levels, include all intervening crypto days
joint_VAR.recursive_order: VIX, USD, yield, BTC, ETH; reverse macro order sensitivity
joint_VAR.interpretation: recursive structural restrictions assumed, not proven exogeneity; never label yield innovation pure monetary surprise

monetary_LP.shock: SF Fed STMT per 10bps, retrospective PCA measure; policy news, not pure policy
monetary_LP.sample: all statement events with STMT and daily prices/controls, one event per date; no Coinbase-minute coverage selection
monetary_LP.outcome: sum of UTC daily returns D+1 through D+h; event day D excluded, so no pre-announcement return enters the outcome
monetary_LP.controls: own daily return and trailing30 RMS from D-2, VIX proxy admitted by start of D
monetary_LP.inference: HAC lag5 over event order; approximate for event spacing/overlapping horizons; pointwise 95%
monetary_LP.regime: full plus pooled stress interaction; no inferential claim that significant state slopes imply different slopes
monetary_LP.BH: 60 full STMT coefficients; 60 stress slope differences separately

quantile.controls: current 4 macro information updates + previous calendar crypto return
quantile.bootstrap: moving circular blocks of rows, fixed length20, 99 replicates, seed9; percentile pointwise 95%, exploratory finite Monte Carlo approximation

forecast: Reuse approved completion ablations and positive variance models; reconstruct persisted learned artifacts and validation-only grouped circular-permutation importance, 10 repeats, seed9. Do not retune using test.
untouched_test: No new untouched results claimed. Freeze artifacts now and provide prediction-before-outcome logging for a future evaluation window starting 2026-10-20.
limitations: 24h timing assumption is not archived provider delivery
VIX/S&P/gold and crypto remain retrospective proxies
VAR adequacy must be reported even if diagnostics fail
quantile bootstrap intervals are approximate, not causal
